schema.text: When you use public transport, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I travel another way (e.g. by car instead of by bus)

schema.help: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

en.#When you use public transport, what do: When you use public transport, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?
en.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: I notice it, but I don't change anything
en.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: I travel another way (e.g. by car instead of by bus)
en.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto invece che in autobus)
it.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensa all’attesa alla fermata e al viaggio a bordo dei mezzi pubblici. Se fai più di una di queste cose, scegli quella che fai più spesso.
it.#I travel at another time: Mi sposto in un altro orario

fr.#When you use public transport, what do: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture plutôt qu'en bus)
fr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensez à l’attente aux arrêts et au trajet à bord des transports en commun. Si vous faites plusieurs de ces choses, choisissez celle que vous faites le plus souvent.
fr.#I travel at another time: Je me déplace à un autre horaire

de.#When you use public transport, what do: Was tun Sie bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, wenn die Luft schlecht ist (Abgase, Staub, schlechte Gerüche)?
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Ich schütze mich, z. B. mit einer Maske
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Auto statt Bus)
de.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Denken Sie an das Warten an Haltestellen und die Fahrt in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Wenn Sie mehrere dieser Dinge tun, wählen Sie das aus, was Sie am häufigsten tun.
de.#I travel at another time: Ich fahre oder gehe zu einer anderen Zeit los

tr.#When you use public transport, what do: Toplu taşıma kullanırken hava kötü olduğunda (egzoz dumanı, toz, kötü kokular) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otobüs yerine otomobille)
tr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Duraklarda beklemeyi ve toplu taşıma araçlarında yolculuk yapmayı düşünün. Bunlardan birden fazlasını yapıyorsanız en sık yaptığınızı seçin.

fa.#When you use public transport, what do: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، وقتی هوا آلوده است (دود اگزوز، گردوغبار، بوی بد) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing, it doesn't affect me: هیچ کاری، بر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با ماسک
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو به جای اتوبوس)
fa.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: انتظار در ایستگاه‌ها و سفر با وسایل حمل‌ونقل عمومی را در نظر بگیرید. اگر بیش از یکی از این کارها را انجام می‌دهید، کاری را انتخاب کنید که بیشتر انجام می‌دهید.

hu.#When you use public transport, what do: Tömegközlekedés közben mit tesz, ha rossz a levegő (kipufogógáz, por, kellemetlen szagok)?
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: Más módon utazom (pl. autóval busz helyett)
hu.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Gondoljon a megállókban való várakozásra és a tömegközlekedési járműveken való utazásra. Ha ezek közül többet is tesz, válassza azt, amit a leggyakrabban tesz.

ar.#When you use public transport, what do: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما تصرّفك عندما يكون الهواء سيئًا (عوادم المركبات أو الغبار أو الروائح الكريهة)؟
ar.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: ألاحظ ذلك، لكنني لا أغيّر شيئًا
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by car inste: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالسيارة بدل الحافلة)
ar.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: فكّر في الانتظار في المحطات والسفر على متن وسائل النقل العام. إذا كنت تفعل أكثر من أمر من هذه الأمور، فاختر ما تفعله غالبًا.
